deepmind-research/enformer.role: documents the model and its use (README.md, enformer-usage.ipynb: tensorflow_hub.load(handle).model.predict_on_batch); the network that runs is the TF-Hub SavedModel below, exported by the authors from this code
deepmind-research/enformer.note: the repository's Sonnet module route (enformer.py + the sonnet_weights checkpoint) requires dm-sonnet 2.0.0 / TensorFlow 2.5 (requirements.txt), which do not run on this stack; it is not served

tfhub:deepmind/enformer/1.cache_layout: TFHUB_CACHE_DIR/c444fdff3e183daf686869692c26e00391f6773c/{saved_model.pb, variables/} — tensorflow-hub's own cache (hub.load resolves the handle offline when the directory exists)
tfhub:deepmind/enformer/1.input: float32 one-hot (B, 393216, 4) in ACGT order (N = zeros); the graph uses the central 196,608 bp
tfhub:deepmind/enformer/1.exported_with: tensorflow 2.4 (the SavedModel's own metadata); prediction function __inference_predict_on_batch with one concrete signature

library_defaults.note: the stock call the kit reproduces: predict_on_batch under TensorFlow's own defaults — float32, TF32 tensor-core arithmetic enabled by TensorFlow on compute capability 8.0 and newer, cuDNN autotuning as TensorFlow ships it, the SavedModel's function optimized by TensorFlow's default graph passes; the kit sets no TensorFlow option and no environment variable
